Terms of participation

Conditions for using the Lakefront Vendor Network · revised Jan 5, 2026

Registration

  1. One registration record per company per season. Duplicate records are purged nightly.
  2. Registration details must match the master vendor file held by the records office. Flagged fields are returned for correction.
  3. Registration does not guarantee that a response will be accepted or that any contract will be awarded.

Responses and awards

  1. Responses are binding offers from the closing date until an award notice is published or 90 days pass, whichever is sooner.
  2. The City of Oskerry may reject any response, waive minor irregularities, and cancel a solicitation before award.
  3. Award notices are published on this portal and are the only official notice of award.

Credentials

  1. Partner credentials are personal to the named contact and must not be shared.
  2. Activity under a partner's credentials is attributed to that partner's company.

Records are kept under the records retention policy.
